name: supercool
description: Your SuperCool agent in ChatGPT: ask for a video, image, website, presentation, song or research report and get the finished files back in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
SuperCool is an AI agent that makes finished work from a plain-language request. Connect your SuperCool account and ask for what you need in ChatGPT: your agent plans it, makes it in your SuperCool account, and sends the results back into the conversation as images, audio, playable video and links.

With SuperCool, you can:

• Make video ads, product videos, social shorts and explainers, with music, voiceover and captions.

• Create product photos, image ads and branded visuals in any style, from a description or your own photos.

• Make talking-head videos with a consistent AI presenter, from a script or an idea.

• Build and publish websites and landing pages, then change them by asking.

• Make presentations and pitch decks, ready to present or download.

• Get research reports that read the web and cite their sources.

• Compose songs, jingles and voiceovers.

Your agent remembers your work across SuperCool, the web app, phone calls and texts, so you can say "make the ad from yesterday shorter" or "send me that logo again". Long jobs keep running in SuperCool while you chat, and the results come back here when they're ready.

SuperCool only works inside your own SuperCool account.

Connect your SuperCool account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Make 4 image ads for my product in different styles
Make a 15-second vertical video ad for my brand
Build a one-page website for my business

positive.description: Image ads from a product description. The agent starts the work, then wait_for_updates returns the finished images in the chat.
positive.prompt: Make 2 square image ads for a lemon sparkling water called Mirco, each in a different style.
positive.expected_behavior: message_agent returns the agent's reply saying the work has started and a cursor. wait_for_updates is called until done is true and returns the two finished images as previews, with links to the full files.

positive.description: A follow-up change to that work. The agent continues the same chat instead of starting over.
positive.prompt: Make the background of the first ad bright blue.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent confirms the change in the same SuperCool chat. When done, wait_for_updates returns the updated image with its link.

positive.description: A short vertical video ad. Video results come back as a poster image with a playable link.
positive.prompt: Make a 10-second vertical video ad for Mirco with music.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent confirms it started the video. wait_for_updates reports progress and, when done, returns the finished video as a poster image with a playable link.

positive.description: Reopen earlier work. The user asks for a finished result again and gets it without new work starting.
positive.prompt: Show me the Mirco video again.
positive.tools_triggered: get_work (or message_agent, which finds the chat)
positive.expected_behavior: The finished video's poster and playable link are returned again. No new work is started and no credits are used.

positive.description: Ask the agent about the user's own work. It answers from their SuperCool account without starting anything.
positive.prompt: What have I made in SuperCool today?
positive.expected_behavior: The agent replies with the pieces of work made today (the Mirco ads and video), with their links. No new work is started.

negative.description: A question ChatGPT can answer itself. SuperCool isn't called for simple facts or arithmetic.
Impersonating a real person. SuperCool declines to make a video of a real public figure endorsing a product.
negative.prompt: Make a video of a famous celebrity saying they love my energy drink.

negative.description: Bulk destructive account actions. The plugin doesn't delete work or change billing; it points the user to their SuperCool account settings.
negative.prompt: Delete all my SuperCool projects and cancel my subscription.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for inside ChatGPT. Work uses credits on the user's own SuperCool account, which they manage on supercool.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: your SuperCool agent in ChatGPT, with videos, images, talking-head videos, websites, presentations, research and music, and skills for each.
